output.summary: An herbaceous perennial originating in Asia, ginger grows annual leafy false stems and sends pale yellow, purple-edged flowers directly from its underground stem. This fragrant, pungent stem is widely used as a spice, including fresh, dried, pickled and candied forms.
output.edibilityNote: The underground stem is eaten or used as a spice fresh, dried, pickled or candied; leaves have also flavored food or been eaten.
